months.note: 봄과 가을에 지나가며, 번식지에서는 5월 상순~6월 하순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을 이동 시기에 적은 수가 지나가는 나그네새로, 바닷가, 호수, 습지, 풀밭 등에서 지낸다. 홀로 또는 4~5마리씩 작은 무리를 지어 다니며, 물속 곤충과 민물조개 따위를 먹는다. 한배에 알을 4개쯤 낳는다.

art.subject: Marsh Sandpiper (Tringa stagnatilis), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean coastal marshes in April-May: whitish face with fine dark streaks on the crown, hindneck and ear coverts; mantle, scapulars and tertials grey to grey-brown with bold black centres, bars and chevrons and pale edges; foreneck and breast white with fine dark streaks and spots, a few dark chevrons on the flanks; belly and undertail white; fine, needle-like black bill; dark eye; long slender greenish to yellowish-green legs.
art.pose: wading in shallow water, picking aquatic insects from the surface
art.scene: Korean coastal marsh and lakeside wetland during spring migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view wading in shallow water: small rounded head, needle-thin straight black bill, grey back feathers with black centres and bars, white underparts with fine streaks on the breast, very long greenish-yellow legs
upperparts detail, side view of the folded wing and back: each grey mantle, scapular and tertial feather with black streaks, bars and chevrons and a pale edge
adult in flight, seen from above, head, body and tail in line: dark wings without a wing-bar, white wedge up the back, feet projecting well beyond the tail
art.build: Small, slim, elegant Tringa sandpiper, 25cm long but with a small body about the size of a Common Starling's, set on very long thin legs; long slender neck and small rounded head. Bill black, straight, needle-thin from base to tip, longer than the head. Legs very long, greenish to yellowish-green, with much bare tibia. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip or slightly beyond. In flight dark wings without a wing-bar, a long white wedge from the rump up the back, a pale finely barred tail, and the feet trailing well beyond the tail tip.
avoid: Do not paint a thick bill with a grey base and upturned tip - that is Common Greenshank (Tringa nebularia), which is also much bigger; this bill is needle-thin and straight.
Do not paint short legs, or orange or red legs.
Do not give it a white wing-bar or a dark rump.
Do not make the body heavy or the neck short.
